sentences.en: holly : Hello Dr Green – I'm here to talk to you about my work placement
sentences.zh: HOLLY：您好，格林博士，我今天来是想跟您谈谈我的实习安排。

sentences.en: tutor : Oh yes, it's Holly, isn't it?
sentences.zh: TUTOR：哦，对了，你是霍莉，没错吧？

sentences.en: holly : Yes
sentences.zh: HOLLY：是的。

sentences.en: tutor : So, which work placement have you chosen?
sentences.zh: TUTOR：那么，您选择的是哪项实习安排呢？

sentences.en: holly : I decided to go for the Orion Stadium placement
sentences.zh: HOLLY：我决定选择奥赖恩体育场的实习岗位。

sentences.en: The event I'll be managing is one where I'm helping to set up a sports competition for primary school children
sentences.zh: 我将负责组织一场面向小学生的体育竞赛活动。

sentences.en: tutor : Yup
sentences.zh: TUTOR：嗯。

sentences.en: That's always a popular placement – even though it can be tougher than you think working with children
sentences.zh: 这向来是一个颇受欢迎的实习岗位——尽管与儿童共事的实际难度可能超出您的预期。

sentences.en: holly : I know, but it's the fresh air that attracts me – organising something indoors doesn't have the same appeal, even though it might be fun
sentences.zh: HOLLY：我知道，但真正吸引我的是户外的新鲜空气——室内活动的组织工作虽可能有趣，却缺乏同样的吸引力。

sentences.en: tutor : OK, so obviously safety's going to be one of your key concerns for this event
sentences.zh: TUTOR：好的，那么显然，本次活动的安全问题将是您的首要关切之一。

sentences.en: holly : Yes, I've already thought about that
sentences.zh: HOLLY：是的，这一点我已提前考虑过了。

sentences.en: I'll need to make sure none of the equipment's damaged
sentences.zh: 我需要确保所有器材均无损坏。

sentences.en: tutor : Ah well, you'll be working with schools, so the equipment will be their responsibility
sentences.zh: TUTOR：啊，不过您将与各所学校合作，因此器材本身由校方负责。

sentences.en: However, the grounds and what goes on there will be yours
sentences.zh: 然而，场地及其上开展的所有活动则由您负责。

sentences.en: holly : Oh I see – that'll include keeping everyone within the boundary once they're in their kit and on the field?
sentences.zh: HOLLY：哦，我明白了——也就是说，一旦孩子们换好运动服进入场地，我就需确保所有人始终留在划定区域内？

sentences.en: tutor : Exactly – you'll need to inspect areas like changing rooms as well for anything someone can trip over, but your main priority will be not to lose anyone!
sentences.zh: TUTOR：完全正确——您还需检查更衣室等区域，排除可能导致人员绊倒的隐患，但您的首要任务是绝不能让任何人走失！

sentences.en: holly : Right
sentences.zh: HOLLY：明白。

sentences.en: I'll need staff to help with that
sentences.zh: 我需要工作人员协助完成这项工作。

sentences.en: tutor : And don't forget about the spectators
sentences.zh: TUTOR：另外，别忘了观众。

sentences.en: holly : Mmm
sentences.zh: HOLLY：嗯。

sentences.en: I was thinking that many of them will be parents, who could help run the event
sentences.zh: 我在想，其中很多观众会是孩子的家长，或许能协助活动运行。

sentences.en: tutor : I wouldn't rely on that
sentences.zh: TUTOR：我不建议您依赖这一点。

sentences.en: They'll be more interested in filming their children than volunteering
sentences.zh: 他们更热衷于拍摄自己孩子的影像，而非主动提供志愿服务。

sentences.en: holly : I'll need to make sure they don't interfere with events doing that!
sentences.zh: HOLLY：我必须确保他们不会因拍摄而干扰活动进程！

sentences.en: tutor : And that's not always easy, especially when a proud parent's trying to get a snap of their child and you want them to move elsewhere
sentences.zh: TUTOR：这并非易事，尤其当一位自豪的家长正努力抓拍自己孩子的瞬间，而您却需要请他移步至其他位置时。

sentences.en: holly : OK
sentences.zh: HOLLY：好的。

sentences.en: What about the scheduling?
sentences.zh: 那么关于日程安排呢？

sentences.en: tutor : With sporting events there are all sorts of things that can alter the timetable – like rain, for instance – though so far, we've always been lucky with that
sentences.zh: TUTOR：体育赛事存在诸多可能影响时间表的因素——例如降雨——不过到目前为止，我们在天气方面一直很幸运。

sentences.en: holly : Yeah, and I was thinking about what to do if someone got hurt as well
sentences.zh: HOLLY: 是啊，我也在考虑如果有人受伤了该怎么办。

sentences.en: I know that last year that caused a terrible delay
sentences.zh: 我知道去年这就造成了严重的延误。

sentences.en: tutor : You have to be prepared for such things
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 你必须为这类事情做好准备。

sentences.en: holly : Oh
sentences.zh: HOLLY: 哦。

sentences.en: What if a match ends in a draw – do you let the teams keep going until someone wins?
sentences.zh: 如果一场比赛以平局结束，你们是让两支队伍继续比赛直到分出胜负吗？

sentences.en: tutor : That'll be up to you – and again, you need to plan for it
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 这将由你来决定——而且同样地，你也需要为此提前规划。

sentences.en: holly : Right
sentences.zh: HOLLY: 明白了。

sentences.en: tutor : Now, the aim of your work placement is to give you the opportunity to develop the skills that an events manager needs
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 现在，你这次实习工作的目标是为你提供机会，培养一名活动经理所需具备的各项技能。

sentences.en: So, let's talk about those a bit
sentences.zh: 所以，我们来稍微谈一谈这些技能。

sentences.en: holly : Well, I think my communication skills are pretty good
sentences.zh: HOLLY: 嗯，我觉得我的沟通能力相当不错。

sentences.en: I can talk on the phone to people and book venues and that kind of thing
sentences.zh: 我可以打电话与人交流、预订场地之类的事情。

sentences.en: tutor : Good – just remember it isn't only about what you say
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 很好——但请记住，这并不仅仅关乎你说什么。

sentences.en: If you meet someone face-to-face and want to persuade them to be a sponsor, for example …
sentences.zh: 例如，如果你要面对面会见某人，并想说服对方成为赞助商……

sentences.en: holly : Oh, I'll dress up for that!
sentences.zh: HOLLY: 哦，我会为此精心着装的！

sentences.en: Sure
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: tutor : Good
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 很好。

sentences.en: Let's go on to think about your organisational skills
sentences.zh: 我们接着来谈谈你的组织协调能力。

sentences.en: You're working in a very people-based industry and that means things won't always go to plan
sentences.zh: 你所从事的是一个高度依赖人际互动的行业，这意味着事情并不总能按计划进行。

sentences.en: holly : I guess it's being prepared to make changes that matters
sentences.zh: HOLLY: 我想，关键在于随时准备好做出调整。

sentences.en: tutor : That's right
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 没错。

sentences.en: You may have to make an on-the-spot change to a timetable because of a problem you hadn't anticipated …
sentences.zh: 你可能需要根据一个未曾预料到的问题，当场对时间表作出调整……

sentences.en: holly : … just do it!
sentences.zh: HOLLY: ……那就立刻执行！

sentences.en: OK
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: tutor : How's your time management these days?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 你最近的时间管理能力如何？

sentences.en: holly : I'm working on it – I'm certainly better when I have a deadline, which is why this work suits me
sentences.zh: HOLLY: 我正在努力提升——当然，在有截止期限的情况下我表现得确实更好，这也是这份工作适合我的原因。

sentences.en: tutor : Yes, but it's how you respond as that deadline approaches!
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 是的，但更重要的是，当截止期限临近时你如何应对！

sentences.en: holly : I know I've got to look calm even if I'm in a panic
sentences.zh: HOLLY: 我知道，即使内心慌乱，外表也必须保持镇定。

sentences.en: tutor : Just think to yourself – no one must know I'm under pressure
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 时刻提醒自己——绝不能让别人看出我正承受压力。

sentences.en: holly : Yeah – even though I'm multi-tasking like crazy!
sentences.zh: HOLLY: 是啊——尽管我实际上正疯狂地同时处理多项任务！

sentences.en: tutor : Another skill that events managers need is creativity
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 活动经理所需的另一项技能是创造力。

sentences.en: Often your client has what we call the ‘big picture' idea, but it's up to the events manager to think of all the fine points that go to making it work
sentences.zh: 通常客户会有一个我们称之为‘宏观构想’的想法，但具体落实这一构想的所有细节，则需由活动经理来思考和安排。

sentences.en: holly : Right, so I need to listen carefully to that idea and then fill in all the gaps
sentences.zh: HOLLY: 明白了，所以我需要认真倾听这个构想，然后把所有细节都补充完善。

sentences.en: tutor : That's right
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 没错。

sentences.en: And you'll have a team working under you, so another key skill is leadership
sentences.zh: 而且你手下会有一支团队，因此另一项关键技能是领导力。

sentences.en: Your team may have lots of ideas too, but you've got to make the ultimate choices
sentences.zh: 你的团队成员也可能提出许多想法，但最终决策权仍在你手中。

sentences.en: Do we have refreshments inside or out, for example?
sentences.zh: 例如，茶点是在室内还是室外提供？

sentences.en: holly : Isn't it better to be democratic?
sentences.zh: HOLLY: 难道实行民主决策不是更好吗？

sentences.en: tutor : It's a nice idea, but you have the ultimate responsibility
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 这是个不错的设想，但最终责任仍由你承担。

sentences.en: So, believe in what you think best
sentences.zh: 所以，请相信你自己认为最佳的方案。

sentences.en: Be prepared to say ‘yes', that's a good idea but it won't work here
sentences.zh: 要敢于说：‘是的，这是个好主意，但在此情境下行不通。’

sentences.en: holly : I see what you mean
sentences.zh: holly：我明白你的意思。

sentences.en: What about the networking side of things?
sentences.zh: 那网络关系这一块呢？

sentences.en: I know it's an area that a lot of students worry about because we don't have much experience to offer others
sentences.zh: 我知道这是很多学生担心的领域，因为我们没什么经验可以分享给他人。

sentences.en: tutor : But even without it – you can still be an interesting person with useful ideas
sentences.zh: tutor：但即便没有经验——你依然可以成为一个有趣的人，并拥有实用的想法。

sentences.en: And the more people you impress, the better
sentences.zh: 你给越多的人留下深刻印象，效果就越好。

sentences.en: holly : I guess that will help me when I apply for a real job
sentences.zh: holly：我想这对我申请真正的工作会有帮助。

sentences.en: tutor : Exactly – think ahead – remember what your ambitions are and keep them in mind
sentences.zh: tutor：没错——要未雨绸缪——牢记自己的志向，并始终将其放在心上。

sentences.en: holly : Definitely
sentences.zh: holly：确实如此。
